title: 第112章 九道真神第111章 天纵奇才
content_zh:
第112章九道真神
苏阎将这些繁杂的想法暂时的放下，目前对于自己而言，还是先将这门神通彻底的掌握才是最重要的。
随后他看向面板之处。
【寿元：一百二十年】
这点寿元，想要把《太乙救苦度厄往生真诀》这门大神通完全的掌握恐怕不够。
但好在这门神通分为三部分。
其中第二种“祀火通幽”，需要海量的香火愿力，如今他的身上也没有香火愿力。
所幸可以暂且的先舍弃这第二种能力，先把另外两种实用的领悟了。
苏阎闭目，心神沉入识海深处。
“开始推演。”
识海中字迹翻滚，周遭景物退去。
苏阎闭着眼，脑海中走马观花般闪过无数画面。
他看到自己抓来成千上万的游魂，用真火淬炼，用神识切割。
失败了无数次，炸毁了上千具魂体，才终于摸清了截留功德、重塑魂形的关窍。
【耗费五十年时间，你尝试炼制万千魂魄，最终成功掌握‘阴神凝形神法’。】
趁着感悟正浓，他立刻转入第二门神通的推演。
幻境再一次发生改变，这一次他沉浸在对气机的捕捉与因果的锁定中。
在千万次的尝试中，他学会了如何凭空捏造魂形，如何隔空斩杀目标。
【耗费六十年时间，你成功掌握‘摄魄斩形真解’】
【所剩寿元：十年】

幻境碎裂，苏阎揉了揉胀痛的眉心，压下神魂深处传来的疲惫感。
还好，身上的这些寿元刚好够用。
‘阴神凝形神法’便是炼制护法神之法，而‘摄魄斩形真解’，则是捕捉气机、斩杀神魂的绝杀手段。
虽然掌握了，但接下来得实际操练一番。
随后苏阎翻手取出那枚暗金色的命魂续存印。
这法印里关着上万道凡人魂魄，正好可以用来练手。
护法神的强度与生前修为挂钩，被炼制者生前实力越强，护法神能承载的因果就越大。
他现在手头没别的好货色，只能拿这些凡人魂魄凑合。
苏阎心念一动，从法印中拽出一道魂魄。
“出！”
法印表面暗金纹路亮起，一道虚幻人影被强行抽了出来。
content_en:
Chapter 112 Nine True Gods
Su Yan put aside these complicated thoughts for the time being. For him, the most important thing now is to fully master this magical power.
Then he looked at the panel.
[Shouyuan: one hundred and twenty years]
With this longevity, I'm afraid it's not enough to fully master the great magical power of "Taiyi's True Secret to Saving Suffering and Enduring Rebirth".
But fortunately, this magical power is divided into three parts.
The second type of "Sacrificing Fire to Tongyou" requires a large amount of incense and fire power, and now he does not have the incense and fire power.
Fortunately, we can temporarily abandon this second ability and understand the other two practical ones first.
Su Yan closed his eyes and his mind sank into the depths of the sea of ​​consciousness.
"Start the deduction."
The writings rolled in the sea of consciousness, and the surrounding scenery receded.
Su Yan closed his eyes, and countless scenes flashed through his mind.
He saw that he had captured thousands of wandering souls, tempered them with real fire, and cut them with spiritual consciousness.
After countless failures and thousands of soul bodies blown up, I finally figured out the key to retaining merit and reshaping the soul shape.
[After spending fifty years trying to refine thousands of souls, you finally succeeded in mastering the 'Yin Shen Condensation Divine Technique'. 】
While he was gaining insights, he immediately turned to the deduction of the second magical power.
The illusion changed again. This time he was immersed in the capture of Qi and the locking of cause and effect.
In thousands of attempts, he learned how to fabricate soul shapes out of thin air and how to kill targets from a distance.
[After spending sixty years, you have successfully mastered the ‘True Knowledge of Taking Soul and Cutting the Form’]
[Life remaining: ten years]
The illusion shattered, Su Yan rubbed the painful swelling between his eyebrows, suppressing the feeling of exhaustion deep in his soul.
Fortunately, the lifespan on my body is just enough.
The 'Yin Shen Form Condensation Divine Technique' is a method for refining the protector god, while the 'Shen Jie Shao Zhan Xing Zhen Jie' is a decisive method to capture Qi and kill the soul.
Although you have mastered it, you still need to practice it in practice.
Then Su Yan turned over his hand and took out the dark golden Life Soul Retention Seal.
This seal contains tens of thousands of mortal souls, which can be used to practice your skills.
The strength of the Dharma Protector is linked to his previous cultivation. The stronger the person being refined is, the greater the cause and effect the Dharma Protector can bear.
He has no other good stuff at hand now, so he can only make do with these mortal souls.
With a thought in his mind, Su Yan pulled out a soul from the seal.
"Get out!"
The dark gold lines on the surface of the seal lit up, and an illusory figure was forcibly drawn out.
